player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I entered a loop between Solarium and Mudroom without tracking visited rooms, causing me to mark the task as complete prematurely while other rooms (like the Foyer's neighbors) remained unvisited. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will check if all available directions lead to already visited locations before issuing "DONE". If any direction leads to an unvisited room, I will prioritize that direction to ensure full coverage. Specifically, when in Solarium or Mudroom, I will verify if the destination of a move is new before deciding to stop.
